registered_command_note: host has no `python` executable; the registry maps python -> python3 and the harness executed the mapped argv

No sibling leakage.detail: tests/evaluation/test_splits.py proves the premise and the control: a seeded naive per-entry random assignment demonstrably puts siblings on opposite sides of a boundary (test fails if it ever cannot), while whole-group assignment can never straddle one for any seed. lineage.sibling_groups unions entries over shared group_id/fixture-family, control<->variant edges, and identical sha256 bytes; split_violations flags any group spanning splits, identical bytes under different names in two splits, a sibling moved to evaluation, public siblings entering the evaluation denominator, and reuse of a claim split group by the held-out split. test_freeze.py adds content-addressed corpus grouping: byte-identical entries union whole declared families transitively (F01 mapping-control and F07 geometry-control are the same bytes, so F01+F07 resample as ONE cluster) and corpus_page_keys collapse identical sources to one sample unit. Committed manifests: verify-splits over development.corpus.json (32 entries) + public.corpus.json (7 entries) reports 39 entries, zero violations; both are regenerated byte-exact from fixtures/manifest.json by emit-corpus --check.

skipped/failed pages remain coverage den.detail: metrics.supported_coverage denominators are label-declared supported_failure pages, never reader-chosen: the ten-page corpus with one read and nine skipped scores 0.1 with the nine uncovered pages listed; failed/timeout/cancelled/never-attempted each stay visible per-status (uncovered_statuses + never_attempted); abstain-everywhere scores 0.0, not precision-by-silence; unsupported-truth pages stay out of the supported recall denominator but inside full_coverage (4/4 corpus accounting); clean_false_alerts divides by every labeled clean page and reports pages_read so a nearly-unread corpus cannot hide; check_accounting treats a missing planned check as a violation, never agreement (terminal fraction <1). Label/corpus coverage itself fails closed: every corpus page must be labeled and every label must name a frozen corpus page (check_labels_cover_corpus).

repeated OCR readings are not independen.detail: collapse_readings keys every reading to its content page (sha256:page): five re-reads of twenty pages are twenty samples, never one hundred; the duplicated-reading corpus produces identical rate and identical Wilson bounds as the single-reading corpus; the emitted interval equals wilson(20,20), strictly wider than the dishonest wilson(100,100) the suite asserts it must not emit; a failed first attempt stays reported beside a later success (statuses tally preserved); the same alert re-surfaced by a re-read counts once while a distinct new alert counts. Uncertainty resamples whole document/generator groups via grouped_bootstrap_ci (deterministic seed), so sibling pages and repeated OCR passes can never masquerade as independent evidence.

targets reported as unmet until real run.detail: status_report marks every declared target UNMET with reason no_evaluation_run; the committed plan prints all 10 targets UNMET and exits 1 (custody-demo.txt). The plan format cannot carry a verdict: closed ALLOWED_PLAN_KEYS plus a SELF_ATTEST_KEYS scan reject verdict/status/attested fields at any depth. A run claiming success is input to scoring, never a verdict: validate_run enforces the closed RUN_KEYS shape, terminal CheckResult statuses only, a full frozen candidate (commit + lock_sha256 + config_sha256), and resolutions that must name their evidence (finding_ids / comparison_ref on a completed check); evaluate() binds run.corpus_manifest_sha256 to the exact manifest digest and rejects runs bound to another corpus. With a real bound run, verdicts are computed per target: below-threshold -> UNMET with observed value, unmeasured metric -> UNMET not_measured, zero evaluated findings is not a vacuous precision pass, and min_samples gates verdicts (insufficient_evidence).

small real incident data stays permissio.detail: resolve_labels fails closed without an explicit --label-root/INKFLIP_EVAL_LABEL_ROOT, refuses any root inside a repository checkout (worktrees are not custody), requires the label file to match the plan's pinned sha256 and label_count exactly, and validate_permissioned_labels requires a consent_ref per page so real incident data without consent never enters scoring. Emission is guarded twice: serialize_report/_write_json run scan_forbidden_keys over every artifact (exact keys AND embedded tokens like per_page_truth, page_consent_ref) and assert_labels_not_emitted scans serialized bytes for every label-content string (incident refs, consent refs, notes) before anything is written. custody-demo.txt shows a real permissioned evaluate succeed with the label root outside the checkout, the emitted permissioned-eval.json asserted free of incident_ref/consent_ref, and both the missing-root and in-tree-root invocations refused (exit 2).

additional_coverage.intervals: Wilson bounds verified against known values (0.888248.. for 39/44, perfect-score lower 0.963005.. strictly below 1, n=0 returns the widest (0,1)); grouped bootstrap is deterministic under a fixed seed and clusters by group
additional_coverage.diagnosis: blinded_review_form items carry digests/page refs and null label slots only (no truth); adjudicate needs >=2 independent reviewers, keeps every disagreement with rationales, counts unresolved disputes in the denominator not the numerator, and requires a recorded rationale for any adjudicated decision; counterbalanced_assignments is a deterministic Latin square and task_order shuffles deterministically per tester; diagnosis_summary computes understanding rate and per-tester median time improvement
additional_coverage.manifests: closed corpus_manifest shape (exact key sets, bounded source_path without '..', hex digests, unique pages); evaluation.plan.json pins development/public_demo manifest digests, the permissioned label-store descriptor, population minimums (300 clean + 300 supported_failure pages across >=12 mechanism groups) and the retirement policy
additional_coverage.freeze: emit-corpus is deterministic; --check byte-verifies committed manifests against fixtures/manifest.json; runs must pin the corpus manifest digest and a full candidate freeze
additional_coverage.occurrences: occurrence_preservation denominates only label pages declaring expected_occurrences, uses the conservative minimum across completed readings, and counts unread/failed pages as lost
